title: Take the Greenpill with Greenpill Nigeria
dek: From May 5 to July 14, 2025, Greenpill Nigeria ran a ten-week ReFi and public goods workshop series with eight Web3 communities.
excerpt: Greenpill Nigeria's Take the Greenpill series taught ReFi, public goods, DAOs and DePIN to more than 250 learners, the chapter reports.
body:
Take the Greenpill was a 10-week ReFi and public goods workshop series that Greenpill Nigeria ran from May 5 to July 14, 2025. Its aim was to demystify regenerative finance and public goods for Nigerian Web3 communities, so people would not only learn about them but build with purpose.

The workshops were delivered online, four hours over two days for each community. In its recap on the Regen Coordination Hub on August 5, 2025, the chapter reported reaching 8 Web3 communities and more than 250 learners across 16 sessions.

## What the series covered

- What ReFi is, beyond DeFi
- Public goods, and why open, free infrastructure matters
- DAOs and new ways to coordinate
- DePIN and climate
- Examples such as Gitcoin and Greenpill Network

Learners used tools including POAP, Impact Miner and Karma GAP.

## Closing with Ethereum at 10

The series closed with in-person Ethereum at 10 meetups in Awka and Enugu, which the chapter reported drew more than 70 builders, learners and leaders for talks, networking and games. Next, the chapter planned to launch local environmental work, starting with Water Cup.
